entities.summary: Angelica Danielle "Angel" Robinson is an American-Montenegrin former professional basketball player who played for the Phoenix Mercury of the Women's National Basketball Association (WNBA). Before signing with the Storm in 2014, she was drafted number 20 overall in the 2010 WNBA draft.
